purpose: Read-only supplemental diagnostics for assignment-aligned editable presentation; every quantitative value is from the preserved full runs or their saved reference

definitions.tracking: actual 3D virtual tip minus target at the same time
definitions.paired_deviation: disturbed actual 3D virtual tip minus normal actual at the same time
definitions.published_rmse: 3D tracking RMSE using only pen-down samples; lift/travel excluded
definitions.full_peaks: 3D Euclidean error at native 1 kHz sample rate; no plot decimation when determining peaks
definitions.traces: 19 <= t < 27 seconds, every tenth recorded 1 ms sample; 800 points per curve; units tau=N*m and error=mm
definitions.recovery: After force end, paired 3D deviation <=2 mm continuously for at least 0.5 s; report stable-window start minus force-end time

robot.control_mode: real joint efforts passed through set_dof_efforts at 1 kHz
robot.common_initialization: All controllers begin after 1 s of GC-PD settling at initial IK q, with adaptive weights zero and not trained
robot.pen_contact: visual geometry only; no physical pen-table contact or added pen load
robot.ink_projection: actual tip XY is displayed on draw_z+0.001 m; stored actual XYZ and 3D errors are unprojected

reference.position_residual_definition: Euclidean norm of URDF FK virtual-tip position minus saved Cartesian IK target at each planning knot
reference.orientation_residual_definition: acos((trace(R_hand.T @ diag(-1,1,-1))-1)/2), rad; recomputed from the exact saved planner URDF and q knots
reference.ik_algorithm: First pose Lula IK; subsequent poses warm-started at preceding q and solved using finite-difference 6x7 spatial Jacobian with damped least squares, bounded steps, backtracking, joint-limit clipping; no independent global branch reselection
reference.trajectory_algorithm: SVG outline polylines; eight pen-down contours with 0.025 m lifts; quintic arc-length timing per motion section; 60 Hz Cartesian positions; continuous local IK; knot dq=np.gradient(q,time) with endpoints zero; cubic Hermite interpolation to 1 kHz q_ref and its analytic dq_ref
reference.hermite_continuity: q_ref and dq_ref continuous at knots (C1). qdd_ref is generally discontinuous at knots (not C2); diagnostic qdd is analytic only and is not used by current controllers.

recovery.metric: 3D distance between disturbed and normal positions at the same time
